req.title: Root endpoint responds
req.statement: The system shall serve a welcome message at GET / with HTTP 200.

doc.reasoning: The root endpoint should return a welcome message with a 200 status code. Tests should cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: Root Endpoint Positive Case
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the root endpoint '/'
expected: Response JSON contains the expected welcome message
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {
    "message": "Welcome to Task Manager API",
    "docs": "/docs",
    "version": "1.0.0"
}

tests.name: Root Endpoint Negative Case
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to the root endpoint '/'
expected: HTTP status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: Root Endpoint Boundary Case
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the root endpoint '/' with an Accept header for a non-existent media type
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/', headers={"Accept": "application/xml"})
assert response.status_code == 406
